content.title: Diageo to Sell Kenyan Drinks Stakes to Japan’s Asahi for $2.3 Billion
content.summary: Diageo  is to sell its majority stakes in two Kenyan drinks businesses to Japanese brewer Asahi for proceeds of around $2.3 billion.  The U.K. drinks group, which makes Guinness beer, Smirnoff vodka and Gordon’s gin, said it would sell its 65% shareholding in East African Breweries, or EABL, and its roughly 54% stake in distiller UDVK to Asahi.  The remaining shares of UDVK are held by EABL.
